data.name: Move.Title
data.value: Move this lab to a new key

data.name: Move.Explain
data.value:
Use this only when nobody knows the passphrase of “{0}” and the recovery code is lost too.
A new lab key is made, with a new passphrase and a new recovery code, and remembered on this computer. Every PC that is on now is moved to it over the network within a minute — no USB stick, no visit; it keeps its number, its student account and its settings. PCs that are off are moved the next time they connect to this lab, which stays under My labs until they have.
Other teachers' devices will need a new lab file afterwards, and the old backups no longer open this lab.
